mapper.sql: FROM distribution_distributor d LEFT JOIN adapay_member m ON d.distributor_id = m.operator_id AND m.company_id = #{companyId} AND m.operator_type = 'distributor' LEFT JOIN operators o ON d.dealer_id = o.operator_id
mapper.select:
SELECT d.distributor_id AS distributor_id, d.name AS name, d.contact AS contact, d.mobile AS mobile, d.split_ledger_info AS split_ledger_info, d.address AS address, d.created AS created, m.audit_state AS audit_state, o.username AS username, o.operator_id AS operator_id
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
